content.text:
I found two CSS bugs in `site/css/styles.css`, and fixing both gets the desktop and phone visual tests passing.

- **Portfolio overlap:** `.portfolio-link` had `position: absolute`, which took the portfolio images out of the page flow. The section collapsed and everything below it overlapped. I changed it to `position: relative`.
- **Phone navbar:** the `#mainNav` background was light grey (`#d6dade`) behind white links. I changed it back to the dark `#212529`.

I haven't committed anything. `.idea` and `.vscode` also show as untracked in git. I didn't create them and didn't touch them.
